headline: Nous Research, a maker of open-source AI assistants, has raised $90 million at a value of $1.5 billion to sell its Hermes assistant to businesses.
score_reason: Pool score 6 kept: sizeable round with big backers, from a law firm release and a WSJ exclusive.
importance_line: Companies that want an AI assistant they can control themselves gain a new supplier, but the round is small next to the biggest AI labs.
source: Wall Street Journal, with deal terms from Legal Desire
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports exclusively, and Legal Desire adds the terms from the law firm Sidley, that Nous Research raised $90 million in a Series B round at a value of $1.5 billion, led by Robot Ventures with Nvidia, Microsoft and Samsung among the investors. Nous makes open-source AI models and Hermes Agent, an AI assistant users control themselves, and will use the money to build a version for businesses.
notes: WSJ page blocked; terms read at Legal Desire, which covers the deal from the law firm side. Details of the WSJ exclusive not seen.
